notes.title: Gettysburg: The Tide Turns v1.05
notes.content:
Hi all, we are releasing a new patch: Gettysburg: The Tide Turns is being upgraded to version 1.05. It is a minor one, consisting of some tweaks and fixes.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Fixed USA AI freeze when no more objs to defend
- Fixed MP crash where a enemy unit would sometimes spawn out of the map and freeze the game
- Fixed MP bug where victory checks would show wrong info

tags.bug: - Fixed USA AI freeze when no more objs to defend
- Fixed MP crash where a enemy unit would sometimes spawn out of the map and freeze the game
- Fixed MP bug where victory checks would show wrong info

notes.title: Version 1.04 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Gettysburg: The Tide Turns has been updated to version 1.04! We have fixed some recurring bugs and changed the game saves folder.

Check out the full changelog below!

[U]Changelog:[/U]

- Singleplayer Campaign game can now be continued even if an early victory is achieved
- Fixed victory screen sometimes showing the wrong outcome
- Fixed Tournament scoring
- Fixed AI crash where it didn't have any available rally moves
- Fixed MP freeze where two units would overlap
- Changed save folder to c:\Users\<user name>\Documents\My Games\Gettysburg TTT\ (game will copy the old saves on the first run)
- Fixed Calendar not reporting entry hexes correctly
